title: A report line that says an act happened names its proof, and a check reads that the proof exists
why: Owner 22:20 CST Nov 13 (relayed by the consultant, triage did not see it): it should be confirmed when any session says it marked or sent something that it really happened; he thinks it touches something already agreed. Incidents tonight, as the consultant lists them (unchecked): runner 10's stale "lint PASS isn't on the PR"; the coordinator reported closures it had not read (19:57); triage relayed a message it never received (21:27).
source: Consultant 22:21 CST Nov 13 (quoting the owner); touches global rules verification-verify-against-repo and verification-report-unknown-reads.
note: Triage 22:22 CST Nov 13: guard idea, not built. Check as the consultant states it: a report line that says an act happened (sent, filed, marked ready, closed, merged, posted) names its proof (send_message "delivered", step id on origin/roadmap, PR state by REST, comment id), and lint/report_guard.py reads that the named home exists; otherwise the line must say "unconfirmed". Red case first. The consultant says no mechanism holds those two rules for acts; unchecked by triage. Triage owns one of the three incidents (21:27) and names this as the guard that would have stopped it. Needs a past-ruling and guard-record read, and the false-alarm cost on report_guard.py measured, before any build.
